observations: Clean public application source snapshot; private development history and test binaries are excluded.
GPL-3.0-only applies to the applicable BotStudio material.
Version/hash-bound upstream license supplements and model provenance are supplied.
Complete Qt/native attribution and copyleft dependency source delivery remain unresolved.
This source publication does not approve public installer distribution.

blockers.description: Exact upstream ANTLR 4.9.3, Flatbuffers 25.12.19 and RapidOCR 3.9.2 texts are preserved under release/licenses and copied to upstream notice directories with hash/version checks. No root NOTICE was present in the latter two release trees. Native/Qt attributions remain a separate unresolved blocker; existing published installers are unchanged.

GPLv3/LGPLv3 texts, version-specific source locations and onedir replacement instructions are prepared. The unused QtPdf image plugin/Qt6Pdf.dll are excluded and verified absent. Complete attributions for the remaining Qt/PySide binaries, binary-matched source/build delivery and independent replacement validation remain unresolved.

RapidAI's model-host Apache License 2.0 declaration, v3.9.2 file API records, original file revisions and matching SHA-256/size for all three shipped models are recorded in distribution_materials.json. Collector and bundle verification reject changed or extra models. This resolves model-host redistribution evidence, not a warranty of training-data or patent clearance.

OpenCV's unused FFmpeg backend is excluded and verified absent. Remaining OpenCV, Shapely/GEOS, ONNX Runtime, Pillow, NumPy, CPython, Microsoft VC/UCRT and PyInstaller native components still need a complete binary-to-notice/source map and source/build delivery review.

GPL-3.0-only chosen by Christian Perner; official LICENSE and application LICENSE-NOTICE.txt are present and verified in the private 0.1.0.3 bundle/installer. Dependency compatibility and exact complete Corresponding Source obligations must still be verified before public distribution. Existing 0.1.0.2 assets are unchanged; this item is not yet resolved.
